title: AES SETKEY returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE to force software key schedule
description: What is correct and why: crypto2dev_aes_setkey_ctx() (port.c:530-565) returns CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE after storing the key bytes in devCtx. This forces wolfSSL to also run the software AES key schedule, which sets aes->rounds. wc_AesGcmSetKey needs aes->rounds to precompute the GCM H-subkey; without it, the first wc_AesGcmEncrypt fails with KEYUSAGE_E with no obvious diagnostic. The port's cipher path (crypto2dev_cipher) checks devCtx first and uses hardware regardless. A future contributor who sees 'SETKEY returning CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE seems wrong' and changes it to return 0 would break AES-GCM for all callers using the standard wc_AesSetKey + wc_AesGcmEncrypt pattern.
